subject: Q1 Senior Leadership Capacity: authorization request and band apportionment
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Q1 Senior Leadership Capacity: authorization request and band apportionment

Team —

Attached is the Q1 senior leadership hiring proposal (Q1_2027_Exec_HC_Proposal.xlsx) and a short comp-band summary. This is the consolidated ask from the product, sales, and infra orgs for three executive-level hires we want to start offers for in early January. High level:

- 3 roles: Head of Product Strategy (IC->exec), VP Sales for EMEA, Head of Inference Ops
- Proposed bands and target comp in the spreadsheet; total incremental HC run-rate impact = ~ $2.1M annualized fully-burdened
- Timing: offers to be issued week of Jan 3; two-week acceptance window requested to align with relocation and notice periods

I'm requesting final sign-off on bands and headcount allocations by EOD Thursday (Dec 2). Items I need from each of you:

- Aditya: explicit go/no-go on the overall ask and any push-to-Q2 preferences for cost runway
- Marcus: confirm the VP Sales band + quota-linked comp carve; I flagged a follow-up sheet for your updates
- Lauren: once signed off, HR will draft offer letters and confirm budget coding and approval path for payroll/finance

Notes: Mercer is looped for a quick band validation (cc'd in Drive link). Also included a short doc for board disclosure if we need to escalate.

Attachments: Q1_2027_Exec_HC_Proposal.xlsx (roles, justification, budget), comp-band-summary.pdf

Thanks —
Naomi Feldman
Head of People Strategy
Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0189

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 08:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Q1 Senior Leadership Capacity: authorization request and band apportionment

Thanks Naomi — quick read-through. A couple of high-level asks before I can sign off:

1) Can we get a per-role business case one-pager? Specifically for Head of Inference Ops I want clear SLO improvements or cost-savings expectations tied to hire (not just org enablement language).
2) Given runway sensitivity, can VP Sales be scoped to a later start (mid-Q1 hiring but start date late Q1 / early Q2) if needed? If that shifts, send me updated pro-forma for Q1/Q2 run-rate.
3) If we proceed this cycle, we should prepare a short board note (1 page) highlighting impact and runway assumptions — cc'ing board_secretariat to flag timing.

If the above are addressed I'd be willing to approve the Head of Product Strategy and Head of Inference Ops hires for Jan offers.

On the bands: I don't object to the ranges shown but want to see Mercer confirm market consistency (Naomi, please prioritize).

Aditya
CEO, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com
--

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 10:41:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Q1 Senior Leadership Capacity: authorization request and band apportionment

Naomi / Aditya —

I've reviewed and made a small set of adjustments on the sales band sheet (attached: sales-lead-band-adjustments.xlsx). Primary changes: tightened the OTE corridor for VP Sales EMEA, moved more to quota-bearing variable comp (to align incentives) and adjusted the target commission ceilings to keep on-target payroll within the $900k headcount slice allocated.

I'm supportive of moving forward with Head of Product Strategy and Head of Inference Ops as Aditya suggested — both have high strategic ROI in H1. For VP Sales: I'm OK with hiring the candidate pool and extending offers on a conditional start (if we need to push cash out to Q2, structure offer as "start date TBD" with a nominal sign-on). I'll populate the updated pro-forma for Q1 vs Q2 impact by EOD Wednesday.

Small ask for HR: please include a clause in offer letters for execs regarding relocation support caps and standard sign-on repayment schedule.

Marcus
CRO, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

Date: Thu, 2 Dec 2026 17:38:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Q1 Senior Leadership Capacity: authorization request and band apportionment — FINAL sign-off

All — thanks for the quick turn. Summary and final asks: 

- Aditya: thanks for the conditional approval. Attached is a 1-page business case for Head of Inference Ops (tab: IOP-1Pager in the workbook) and the updated pro-forma reflecting a VP Sales start in early Q2 if needed.
- Marcus: accepted your band adjustments; updated sales-lead-band-adjustments.xlsx is attached.
- Lauren: please proceed to draft offer letters for Head of Product Strategy and Head of Inference Ops (target offer week Jan 3). For VP Sales, draft an offer with a flexible start-date clause per Marcus. Include the relocation cap and sign-on repayment schedule.

Mercer: please confirm market alignment on comp-band-summary.pdf by EOD Friday (Dec 3) so we can include the market note in the board disclosure.

Board Secretariat: if we decide to present this at the Dec 10 board packet, Naomi will circulate the 1-page summary and impact table by Dec 4 for inclusion.

Next steps:
1) HR to prepare offers (Lauren) — due Dec 4 for legal/finance review
2) Mercer to validate bands — due Dec 3
3) Naomi to prepare board one-pager if requested — due Dec 4

I consider this thread closed for sign-off unless anyone raises a redline by EOD Friday. If no objections, HR will proceed with offer issuance upon legal/finance clearance.

Thanks —
Naomi Feldman
Head of People Strategy
Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.com
